name: ua_cecchinato_partload
title: UA part-load scaling after Cecchinato et al. (function library, TESPy)
summary: Function library for the part-load scaling of the overall conductance UA of a heat exchanger: the Cecchinato et al. (2010) law UA/UA_ref = (1+x)/(m_cold^-Re_cold + x*m_hot^-Re_hot), x = (alpha_cold/alpha_hot)*(A_cold/A_hot), with the two-resistance series conductance it is derived from and the building blocks of a sectioned UA. The main program evaluates the factor at the off-design points of the TESPy SectionedHeatExchanger doctest and of the MovingBoundaryHeatExchanger tests, and applies it to a steam condenser cooled by air (design with an imposed pinch, then off design with UA = UA_ref*f_UA).

authors: Luca Cecchinato, Manuel Chiarello and Marco Corradi (Cecchinato et al. 2010)
origin.notes: TESPy commit 19425523 (MIT, Witte & Tuschy). Scientific reference: L. Cecchinato, M. Chiarello, M. Corradi, 'A simplified method to evaluate the seasonal energy performance of water chillers', Int. J. Thermal Sci. 49 (2010) 1776-1786, doi 10.1016/j.ijthermalsci.2010.04.010 (paper itself not consulted; formula taken from the TESPy source and docstring). Translation published under the CoolSolve_Library MIT licence (decision D3).

verification.summary: Compared with a re-run of the TESPy SectionedHeatExchanger doctest (design, off design m = 0.8 and three more flows) and of the three MovingBoundaryHeatExchanger Cecchinato tests with CoolProp R410A instead of REFPROP: 26 common variables, 0 differ at rtol=0.001, max 1.35e-05 (UA). Two-resistance derivation checked to 2e-16.
verification.reference: TESPy 0.11.3.dev0 commit 19425523 re-run in a throw-away venv (CoolProp 8.0.0): SectionedHeatExchanger class doctest (design, UA_cecchinato_hc off design at m = 0.5, 0.6, 0.8, 1.2) and the three MovingBoundary Cecchinato tests (REFPROP replaced by HEOS R410A); 26 values compared with tools/compare_solution.py. The paper values were not checked.
verification.notes: compare_solution.py --all: 26 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001), max 1.35e-05 (UA_1 and UA_sum_2: sectioned UA 273452 vs 273456 W/K, 6+1+6 sections instead of the 52 of TESPy). f_UA values agree to <= 2.9e-11 (same formula, mass-flow ratios from the TESPy run). The REFPROP-based test asserts td_pinch 7.61134 / 4.662423 were not run (REFPROP missing); the HEOS re-run gives 7.611332 / 4.662363.
